title: The MRPL2 Non-native Speech Corpus
why_promising: Primary non-native English production corpus with 4,500 utterances from 23 speakers across 14 L1s; Zenodo states that every utterance is manually annotated for phonetic mispronunciations and that annotated TextGrids plus expected and ground-truth phoneme sequences are included.
open_question: Files are currently restricted on Zenodo. Keep in review until public byte-level access or explicit authorized access is available; then isolate the human TextGrid/ground-truth layer, inventory all files and avoid treating any automatic ASR-derived material as manual core data.
